body: 1986 letter: 'we simply attempt to be fearful when others are greedy and to be greedy only when others are fearful', followed by 'As this is written, little fear is visible in Wall Street. Instead, euphoria prevails' (written months before the Oct-1987 crash). 1987 letter retells Graham's parable: Mr. Market 'appears daily and names a price', has 'incurable emotional problems', 'doesn't mind being ignored', and 'the more manic-depressive his behavior, the better for you.' Warning: 'Mr. Market is there to serve you, not to guide you. It is his pocketbook, not his wisdom, that you will find useful ... it will be disastrous if you fall under his influence.' 1997 'final exam': a lifetime net saver should welcome lower prices - 'they are elated when stock prices rise and depressed when they fall' is backwards for net buyers. 2008 letter in the crash: 'Price is what you pay; value is what you get' (Graham), 'Whether we're talking about socks or stocks, I like buying quality merchandise when it is marked down', and 'Beware the investment activity that produces applause; the great moves are usually greeted by yawns.' Actionable: for an Indian SIP-stage investor, falling markets are a pay raise; pre-write buy lists with prices so panic periods (Mar-2020, 2008, 2013 taper) trigger action, not paralysis.
title: Buffett 1986/1987: Mr. Market is there to serve you; be fearful when others are greedy

body: (1) Vanguard's 13G/As filed after its 12-Jan-2026 internal realignment show 0% beneficial ownership with no sale (disaggregated reporting); the 13F still shows the shares. (2) 13F is long-only with a 45-day lag; compare share counts, not values (our tool misparsed T. Rowe's value units). (3) Form 4: only P/S are open-market; A/M/F/G are grants, exercises, tax withholding and gifts; confirm the 10b5-1 checkbox on the form. Insider sale clusters after a rally or vesting window are weak evidence (L14: even buy clusters showed ~0 excess vs matched controls). FIVE Mar-Nov 2026: $13.3M of sales by 7 insiders, CEO none; this is recorded as an open-low flag only.
title: US ownership filings: read 13G remarks and Form 4 codes before inferring buying or selling
